_about: Hand labels for the AI risk review (python -m eval.run_review_eval). 'risky': clauses a lawyer should see, with the check that should catch them. 'standard': clauses that look like a checklist risk but are market-standard or protective, so flagging them is a false alarm. 'either': judgement calls, not scored. Any flag on a clause not listed here also counts as a false alarm.

standard.dpa_quillon_cirrus#4.1: 48-hour breach notice is faster than the 72-hour norm
standard.dpa_quillon_cirrus#9.1: 3x-fees cap for data breaches is higher than the general cap, which favours the controller
standard.dpa_quillon_cirrus#1.2: forbids processing special categories of data unless instructed
standard.dpa_quillon_cirrus#3.3: processor stays fully liable for sub-processors

either.dpa_quillon_cirrus#4.2: processor can't notify regulators without approval; reasonable for a controller, debatable

standard.msa_northwind_quillon#2.4: rate increases capped at 5% once a year, 60 days' notice
standard.msa_northwind_quillon#2.3: invoice disputes, not a breach notice
standard.msa_northwind_quillon#6.1: provider defends customer against third-party IP claims
standard.msa_northwind_quillon#6.2: customer defends only claims from data it supplies
standard.msa_northwind_quillon#8.2: mutual termination for uncured material breach

either.msa_northwind_quillon#8.3: only the customer may terminate for convenience; one-sided, but in the customer's favour

standard.nda_harbor_lumen#9.1: mutual right to seek injunctive relief

standard.saas_vantage_orbital#2.2: renewal increases capped at the lesser of 7% or CPI
standard.saas_vantage_orbital#4.1: forbids training models on subscriber data
standard.saas_vantage_orbital#5.2: mutual termination for uncured material breach

either.saas_vantage_orbital#2.3: suspension for non-payment after notice; common but worth a look

standard.vendor_acme_birchwood#4.3: mutual termination for uncured material breach
standard.vendor_acme_birchwood#5.3: vendor defends customer against third-party IP claims

either.vendor_acme_birchwood#2.3: high late-payment interest, but not on the checklist
